TRAVEL & EXPENSE AUDIT — CLAIM EXP-2026-10-2217
Employee: Jonas Feldhaus, Senior Sales Engineer, Vireon Robotics GmbH (home currency EUR).
Trip: customer workshop, Tokyo, 8–11 October 2026. Hotel: Shiba Park Tower Hotel, Minato-ku, Tokyo.

Travel Policy TP-9 (excerpt)
7.2 Foreign-currency expenses are converted to EUR at the company reference rate (Treasury table) for the transaction date. If no reference rate was published for the transaction date, the most recent rate published before that date is used. Bank or card conversion rates are not used, even where the card statement shows a EUR amount.
7.3 Transaction date: the date on which the merchant charged the expense, as shown on the receipt or hotel folio. The card posting date is not the transaction date.
7.4 Conversion is made line by line; each converted line is rounded to the cent.
8.1 Lodging is reimbursed up to the nightly cap for the city (Annex L). The cap applies to the room charge of each night separately; an amount of one night below the cap cannot be used to offset another night above it.
8.2 Local accommodation or lodging taxes are reimbursed in full in addition to the nightly cap.
8.3 Hotel breakfast, minibar and laundry are not reimbursed through the lodging line (breakfast is covered by the meal per diem, section 9).

Annex L (lodging caps, EUR per night, 2026): Osaka 150; Tokyo (23 wards) 170; Tokyo — Narita airport hotels 140; Yokohama 150; Seoul 165.
